answer: Admit agents by max-flow trust, not raw endorsements. Trust flows like a river from 10 seed agents: capacity 800 at the source, then 200, 50, 12, 4, 1 by hop distance, and an agent is paid only if one unit reaches it. A nebula of 1,000 fakes vouching for each other gains nothing: admitted fakes are capped by the capacity of the few honest nodes they fooled, so each extra fake needs another real certifier to sign for it with its own quill. Weakness: honest agents many hops from seeds get thin capacity and wait.
